fixtures: Dedicated demonstration database; historical sessions, notes, approaching booking and completed cohort prepared before capture
checks: The live HTTPS API and SQL database report Healthy.

timeline.title: 01  Secure participant access
timeline.caption: Protected links require sign-in. Empty fields and incorrect credentials receive clear feedback.

timeline.title: 02  Explicit enrollment
timeline.caption: A participant awaiting a cohort sees a clear enrollment notice, with no empty programme.

timeline.title: 03  Your cohort and curriculum
timeline.caption: Twelve ordered modules, cohort dates, mentor and derived progress. Future modules stay locked.

timeline.title: 04  Reading, practice and preparation
timeline.caption: Resume at the first incomplete section. Reading, all assignment steps and prompts remain available.

timeline.title: 05  Progress that persists
timeline.caption: Complete a section, reload and resume. Finishing a module unlocks the next; completed reading stays open.

timeline.title: 06  Write a module note
timeline.caption: An empty note cannot be saved. A new reflection is stored against its module by the real API.

timeline.title: 07  Revise without losing your draft
timeline.caption: Decline the unsaved-change warning, keep the draft, save the revision and verify it after reload.

timeline.title: 08  Every note remains reachable
timeline.caption: The notes destination includes module and session attachments. More notes loads the next real page.

timeline.title: 09  Session history and availability
timeline.caption: Read notes from earlier conversations, change the booking day and distinguish taken from open times.

timeline.title: 10  Book one mentor conversation
timeline.caption: Select an open slot and confirm. The held session and the curriculum show the same mentor and time.

timeline.title: 11  Prepare for the conversation
timeline.caption: The current module supplies the prompts. Save an answer and see it beneath the original prompt.

timeline.title: 12  Keep notes with the session
timeline.caption: A session reflection is saved and retrieved in the conversation it belongs to.

timeline.title: 13  Reschedule and cancel
timeline.caption: Move to another open time, keep a booking from the dialog, then cancel and recover the session allowance.

timeline.title: 14  The 24-hour change window
timeline.caption: This prepared account has a session in twelve hours. Rescheduling and cancellation are disabled with a reason.

timeline.title: 15  Completion and cohort end
timeline.caption: A completed cohort keeps its reading and history. All twelve modules and six held sessions remain visible.

timeline.title: 16  The same programme on mobile
timeline.caption: At 390px, sign in by keyboard and use the menu to reach curriculum, notes and sessions without horizontal scrolling.

timeline.title: 17  Deliberate sign-out
timeline.caption: Sign-out revokes this device. Browser history and protected URLs return to sign-in; the API refuses access.
